theorem mvcc.set_replicate_step {α : Type} (done : List α) (z e : α) (m : Nat) (hm : done.length <
    m) : (done ++ List.replicate (m - done.length) z).set done.length e = done ++ [e] ++
    List.replicate (m - (done.length + 1)) z

theorem mvcc.rest_shift (n : Nat) (L : List Loc) (Φ : Nat → Loc → IProp GF) : ([∗list] k ↦ y ∈ L, Φ
    (n + (k + 1)) y) ⊢ [∗list] k ↦ y ∈ L, Φ (n + 1 + k) y

theorem mvcc.syncedBelow_of (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (σ : mvcc.WsState) (hok : mvcc.WsOk σ) (ilog :
    mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) : ([∗map] w ↦ st ∈ σ.ST, mvcc.memberRes γ 1 σ w st) ∗
    monoListAuthOwn γ.st.idx.hist 1 (mvcc.histShape ilog pend) ⊢ ⌜σ.syncedBelow (List.length ilog)⌝

theorem mvcc.ownToks_join_pred (γr : GName) (b : Nat) (h : 1 ≤ b) : ownToks γr (b - 1) ∗ ownToks γr
    1 ⊢ ownToks γr b

theorem mvcc.body_commit (s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (σ : mvcc.WsState) : mvcc.watchStoreBody s γ 1
    σ ⊢ mvcc.logQ γ.st σ.Lmu ∗ ∀ L, ⌜σ.syncedAbove (List.length L) ∧ σ.Lmu <+: L⌝ -∗ mvcc.idxCert
    γ.st.idx L -∗ mvcc.logQ γ.st L ==∗ mvcc.watchStoreBody s γ 1 { Lmu := L, Ws := σ.Ws, Wu := σ.Wu,
    ST := σ.ST, Wo := σ.Wo, M := σ.M, E := σ.E, vs := σ.vs, vbs := σ.vbs, VB := σ.VB }
